strings.W3: 把常打的文字存起来，在任何 App 的键盘上轻点就能输入。
strings.W5: 轻点一下就能复制存好的图片，再粘贴到任何地方。
strings.W6: 数据只留在 iPhone 上
strings.W7: 无需账户，也不用联网。只通过你自己的 iCloud 同步。
strings.A2: 在设置中打开 Cutling，然后回到这个 App
strings.A5: 设置步骤的视频：轻点“键盘”，打开 Cutling，打开“允许完全访问”，再轻点“允许”。
strings.F4: 开启完全访问后，键盘可以复制存好的图片，并添加你复制的内容。
strings.F6: Cutling 没有账户，也从不联网，不会读取你输入的内容。
strings.F8: 任何请求完全访问的键盘，iOS 都会显示同样的警告，不论它做什么。
strings.T2: 在这里用 Cutling 输入
strings.T4: 按住下方的地球键 %@，选择 Cutling，再轻点“试试看”。
strings.T8: 这是 Cutling 帮我输入的
strings.N3: 容量大增，每个键都能输入
strings.N5: 在编辑器里加入空白或今天的日期，每次输入这条内容时再填写空白。
strings.N7: 最多存 %1$@ 条文字和 %2$@ 张图片
strings.N9: 轻点带格式的内容，它和其他内容一样直接输入；按住则连格式一起复制。
strings.N12: 按住键盘上的地球键，然后选择 Cutling。
strings.N14: 轻点一条内容，它就输入到你正在写的地方。
strings.N16: 在任何 App 里，都能把文字、链接或图片分享给 Cutling。
strings.TU1: 输入时轻点花括号按钮，可留出空白，每次使用 Cutling 时再填写。想跳过，请轻点“下一步”。

back.W3: Store the text you often type, and tap it on the keyboard in any app to type it.
back.W5: One tap copies a saved image, then paste it anywhere.
back.W6: Data stays only on the iPhone
back.W7: No account needed, no internet needed. Syncs only through your own iCloud.
back.A2: Turn on Cutling in Settings, then return to this app
back.A5: Video of the Settings steps: tap Keyboards, turn on Cutling, turn on Allow Full Access, then tap Allow.
back.F2: Text types even without turning it on
back.F4: With Full Access on, the keyboard can copy a saved image and add what you copied.
back.F5: Content does not leave the iPhone
back.F6: Cutling has no account, never connects to the internet, and does not read what you type.
back.F8: iOS shows the same warning for any keyboard requesting full access, whatever it does.
back.T4: Hold the globe key % below, choose Cutling, then tap 'Try it out'.
back.T5: Typed; you can start using it
back.N3: Much more capacity, every key types
back.N5: Add a blank or today's date in the editor, and fill in the blank each time you type this item.
back.N7: Save up to %1$@ texts and %2$@ images
back.N9: Tap a formatted item and it types like the others; hold it to copy with the formatting.
back.N12: Hold the globe key on the keyboard, then choose Cutling.
back.N14: Tap an item and it types where you are writing.
back.N16: In any app you can share text, links or images to Cutling.
back.TU1: While typing, tap the curly-brace button to leave a blank, which you fill in each time you use the Cutling. To skip, tap Next.

notes: 你, not 您. Existing locale calls a cutling 剪切片段 but also uses plain Cutling for the keyboard and app; titles and short rows use Cutling and 条 to stay inside the budget. Used 设置, 键盘, 完全访问权限 and “允许完全访问”. Unsure: N15 should reuse the locale's own string if one exists; 随处保存 is mine.
